title: Null-space constrained rank-one edits with compressed Mirror values
hypothesis: LOKI null-space projection protects prior keys; shared Mirror coding of projected edit values reduces bytes while retaining efficacy/locality. Measure projection and compression separately; compare to native PCA.
projection: P=I-KK^T for orthonormal protected key basis K; rank-one right factors are projected into the null space of K^T and normalized to preserve requested edit response.
fit_policy: Value bases fit only on 12 training edits. Heldout edit values are encoded from requested target vectors. Audit efficacy/locality does not enter fitting.
storage: Actual serialized .npz bytes including base matrix, protected/edit keys, projected right factors, value basis/codes, IDs and metadata.
success_gate: Aligned rank-2 world on both seeds: efficacy <=1e-5, locality leakage <=1e-6 and complete bytes <=75% projected full updates. Mirror-specific success further requires better frontier than native PCA.
failure_gate: Quality/locality/storage miss or exact native PCA alias. Fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: Separate projection effects from compression effects
